name: Ikoria
description: The plane of monsters where the Ozolith events occur.

description_citations.text: "Vivien Reid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph join a gathering of bonders and allies in the wilds, greeted by Abda, Vivien Reid and Lukka.
timeline.quote: Zeph was immediately recognized as a formidable monster, and his presence drew attention for both his size and power.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After hearing Lukka and Vivien, Barrow becomes convinced action is needed about the Ozolith, and the pair agree to help reach it.
timeline.quote: Barrow and Zeph agreed to assist in the effort to reach the Ozolith and determine the source of its corruption.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland meet Lukka and Vivien at a crystal formation on the Egali plains and agree to help reach the Ozolith.
timeline.quote: When Vivien and Lukka proposed joining forces to reach the Ozolith, Brin agreed to help

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brin gathers bonded pairs, including Abda and Rigi and Barrow and Zeph, to coordinate a response to the disturbance in monsters.
timeline.quote: Brin's primary concern remained the safety of monsters

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ikoria's monsters begin to mutate, turning the humans' formerly protective fortresses into fodder for the monsters to annihilate.
timeline.quote: the monsters of Ikoria have begun to mutate and the fortresses that were previously successful at protecting humans have now become fodder for the monsters to annihilate

citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Vivien find the winged tiger and learn the Ozolith is forcing monsters to attack Drannith; they escape the hunters on the tiger.
timeline.quote: they escape by riding the winged tiger.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Pursuit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bullied by five older boys as a youth, Lukka later takes revenge on each of them.
timeline.quote: He later exacted revenge on each of them.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien Reid rescues and befriends Lukka, and they theorize he can neutralize the Ozolith.
timeline.quote: She rescued Lukka from his pursuers and befriended him.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka awakes in a swamp on another world, controls one of the beasts there and vows to return home.
timeline.quote: Lukka vowed to one day return home.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Narset spends time on Ikoria seeking enlightenment after confronting Bolas.
timeline.quote: Narset spent some indeterminate amount of time on Ikoria

citation.text: "Narset", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Ikoria Vivien finds the bonded Lukka and learns the Ozolith is the source of the monster attacks.
timeline.quote: Upon further investigation, a big crystal formation called the Ozolith turned out to be the source

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka takes control of the bonders' monsters and Vivien flees with the bonders.
timeline.quote: Vivien tried to fight him but had to flee with the bonders while Lukka went mad with power.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien and the bonders join Jirina's defense of Drannith; Lukka overloads the Ozolith, igniting his spark, and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: This caused his planeswalker's spark to ignite , and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norn sends Lukka to Ikoria to add its monsters to Phyrexian ranks, warning him of the price of failure.
timeline.quote: Go to Ikoria. Add these monsters to our ranks.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ikoria is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion and Vivien arranges its defense with Chevill and Jirina Kudro.
timeline.quote: Vivien took to arranging the defense of Ikoria alongside Chevill and Jirina Kudro .

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrok's flame vaporizes Lukka's amalgam and more omenpaths of Realmbreaker open to Ikoria.
timeline.quote: After Lukka's amalgam was vaporized by Vadrok 's flame, more of Realmbreaker 's omenpaths opened to Ikoria.

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex's invasion force devastates human culture while Ikoria's monsters turn on the invaders.
timeline.quote: Ikoria's monsters focused their ire upon the invaders rather than the local populace.

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina bluffs and leads the survivors and Lukka into Vadrok's lair, where Vadrok's fire destroys him and Vivien's arrows and Vadrok finish him.
timeline.quote: Vadrok's magical fire obliterated Lukka's massive form

citation.text: "Lukka", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka returns to Ikoria compleated and sacks Drannith.
timeline.quote: Lukka returned to Ikoria compleated

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan, and Lukka is burned and finished off by Vivien.
timeline.quote: Lukka was then burned by Vadrok's ethereal fire and finished off by Vivien

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the invasion Vivien helps defend Ikoria; Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan and Vivien finishes him with three spectral arrows.
timeline.quote: She finished the apex monster's work, planting three spectral arrows in Lukka's chest.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ikoria's wrecked cities must be cleared of monsters before rebuilding.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: It was a time for rebuilding, but first Ikoria's wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters.

citation.series: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
citation.text: Coppercoat Vanguard (March of the Machine: The Aftermath, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bello travels beyond Bloomburrow, collecting souvenirs from other worlds, including a hedron from the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: His crowning achievement, he'll add with a grin, is a hedron plucked from the highest point of the Akoum Skyclave.

citation.text: "Bello", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lutri steals an arrow from Vivien Reid's quiver and uses it to release a creature, then vanishes beneath the waves.
timeline.quote: Lutri once stole an arrow from the quiver of the planeswalker Vivien Reid

citation.text: "Otter", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
